title: Signal shell TLAS timeline on GPU and remove host blocking waits
purpose: Prevent UI freeze by avoiding vkWaitSemaphores on the CPU. Signal and wait timeline semaphores on the GPU using SubmitInfo2, and only check readiness non-blockingly on CPU.

steps.detail: Record BLAS builds into a command buffer; submit with VkSubmitInfo2 signaling timeline=N after completion.
Record TLAS build into a command buffer; submit waiting on timeline=N and signaling timeline=N+1 when complete.
In graphics submit for the frame, add a VkSemaphoreSubmitInfo to wait on timeline=N+1. Remove vkWaitSemaphores host wait in MeshParticleRenderer.
Keep a lightweight CPU-side check to print whether lastCompletedBuild >= N+1; do not block the render thread.

acceptance: No window freeze when entering mesh mode
Logs show GPU-side timeline signal/wait values
No vkWaitSemaphores on CPU code path for shell TLAS
notes: Use separate queues if beneficial, but ensure proper queue ownership and barriers. Prefer one submit per stage to simplify.
